look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson six
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 2, lesson T06, Entry, Exit and Profit/Loss; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: Did it make money?
scenes.desc: A trade has a start and an end; four things decide its result: entry, exit, size and fees.

scenes.name: Entry and exit
scenes.desc: Entry is where you open, exit is where you close; a click at 60,000, a move, a click at 61,200.

scenes.name: Quantity and notional
scenes.desc: Quantity 0.05 BTC; notional value = quantity x price = 3,000 USDT; each 100 USDT move is 5 USDT.

scenes.name: Spot profit and loss
scenes.desc: Spot gross PnL = (exit - entry) x quantity: +60 USDT, or -30 USDT.

scenes.name: Unrealized and realized
scenes.desc: An open trade's PnL moves with price; closing locks it in as realized: +60 USDT before fees.

scenes.name: Futures long
scenes.desc: Linear USDT-margined long: (exit - entry) x quantity = -60 USDT; simplified, fees and funding left out; leverage vs margin.

scenes.name: Futures short
scenes.desc: Short: (entry - exit) x quantity: +60 USDT on a fall to 59,400, -80 USDT on a rise to 60,800.

scenes.name: Gross and net
scenes.desc: Fees on entry and exit at an example 0.05%: gross +60, fees 3.00 and 3.03, net +53.97 USDT.

scenes.name: Forgetting fees
scenes.desc: A gross win of +4 USDT becomes a net loss of about -2 USDT after fees; unrealized is not yours yet.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: Pause and work it out: short 0.02 BTC from 60,000 to 61,000 is -20 USDT gross, -21.21 USDT net.

scenes.name: Know the risks
scenes.desc: Price jumps past exits, fees and funding, leverage and liquidation, simple models and no trade.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and one question to check yourself.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: next lesson T07, Market, Limit and Stop Orders.
